description: This file implements the message bus interface functions for the TelcoVoiceManager component, including message handling, bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource freeing, and bus checking. It sets up message bus communication, registers callbacks, and handles session signals.

methods.name: CcspComp_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages, creates a reply, and delegates processing to a base path message function.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initializes connection to the message bus, registers callbacks, and sets up event signals.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Performs component-specific initialization; currently a stub returning success.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup, calls ssp_cancel, and returns status.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the bus status; currently always returns 0.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources based on priority; calls ssp_cancel for high priority.
